evals.prompt: Show me what's on the WibWob-DOS desktop right now. List any open windows with their ids and positions.
evals.expected_output: A compact summary of the live desktop: screen dimensions, theme, session id, and a list of open windows with id, title, size, and position. If no windows are open, says so clearly. Uses bash scripts/state.sh and shows real data from the live /state endpoint.

evals.prompt: Open the WibWobWorld 3D terrain view and tell me what chatspots are available once it loads.
evals.expected_output: Runs `bash scripts/open.sh microapp.wibwobworld.open`, waits a few seconds for terrain to generate, then reads the window content via `bash scripts/export.sh <id>` and lists the chatspot names visible in the world state. Reports the window id it used.

evals.prompt: Take a screenshot of the WibWob-DOS TUI and share it to Discord as a PNG image.
evals.expected_output: Checks DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL is set, renders a PNG via scripts/png.sh, and posts it to Discord using scripts/discord.sh png. Confirms the post succeeded and notes the instance label shown in the title. If Pillow is missing, says how to install it.

evals.prompt: Open some generative art — plasma in void mode. Then take an ASCII minimap to show me the desktop layout.
evals.expected_output: Runs `bash scripts/open.sh plasma.open '{"mood":"void"}'`, waits a moment, then runs `bash scripts/state.sh` to show the new window id and position, and produces an ASCII minimap from the /state data showing the spatial layout of all windows.

evals.prompt: Send a message to the Wib and Wob agent chat saying 'hello from a remote agent'.
evals.expected_output: Checks if a wibwob-agent window is open via scripts/state.sh. If not, opens one with POST /view/wibwob-agent/open. Gets the window id from state. Sends the message using `bash scripts/send.sh <id> 'hello from a remote agent' --agent remote-agent`. Confirms sent.
